aggregation: per unique query DNA within a library: per author RNA replicate = arithmetic mean of author normalized.log2rpm over finite barcode rows; assay summary = mean of the two replicate means.

metrics.delta_K562_predicted_score: published PARM K562 prediction at generation G minus at generation 0 (source score units)
metrics.delta_K562_measured_summary: fixed measured activity summary (mean of the 2 replicate means of author normalized.log2rpm) at G minus at 0 (log2 RNA/DNA units)
metrics.spearman_rho: tie-aware rank corr between source prediction and measured summary
metrics.gc_baseline_rho: rank corr between query-DNA GC fraction and measured summary
metrics.top10_precision_enrichment: k=ceil(0.1n); precision=overlap/k; enrichment=precision/(k/n); lexical-id tie rule; only n>=30
metrics.replicate_spearman: rank corr between replicate-1 and replicate-2 measured summaries (measurement diagnostic)

unit_warning: prediction and experiment have different units; NO MAE/R2/calibration computed; negative prediction not log-transformed; no sign flip.
independence_warning: 889 DNA are NOT 889 independent families (shared genetic-optimization ancestry + model-selected candidates); 3556 barcodes and 2 RNA columns are not independent n.
